q: The relative entropy (KL divergence) D(P||Q) = Σ p log(p/q) satisfies which fundamental inequality?
opts: D(P||Q) ≥ 0 with equality iff P = Q (Gibbs' inequality)
exp: Gibbs' inequality / non-negativity of KL: D(P||Q) ≥ 0 with equality iff P = Q a.e. This follows from the log-sum inequality and is the fundamental fact from which many information inequalities derive.
